purpose: Paired 175-task K=10 frontier-ceiling evaluation over two sealed enrichment arms using the documented qwen3.7-max-preview/qwen3.7-max-2026-05-17 text-weight equivalence class and the Qwen thinking-model completion cap

primary_global_sample_allocation.alias_note: Alibaba documents this alias as equivalent to qwen3.7-max-2026-05-17.

paired_invariant: The exact same model/global-sample allocation, completion cap, thinking budget, sampling policy, and sealed task sequence are applied to both enrichment arms.

invalid_policy_pilot_quarantine.reason: These runs sent max_tokens with thinking enabled. Provider usage demonstrated that reasoning and final-answer accounting did not obey the runner's assumed total-completion cap, so their request/validation policy is not comparable to the clean estimator.
invalid_policy_pilot_quarantine.preservation_policy: Preserve journals and artifacts read-only; never merge their candidates or outcomes into this primary estimator.

reporting.primary: Pooled pass@10 and compile@10 for each enrichment arm over only the two clean K=5 shards
required_diagnostics: Per-model token usage and reasoning-token usage
Separate inventory of invalid-policy pilot artifacts
